parsed.name: Thorlabs FW212C 电动滤光轮
parsed.description: 用于显微镜或其他光学实验光路中的电动滤光轮，可在多个滤光片位置之间切换以选择所需滤光片，并查询当前轮位状态。
parsed.description_en: A motorized filter wheel for microscope and other optical beam paths, used to switch between multiple filter positions to select the desired optical filter and query the current wheel position.

actions.description: 初始化滤光轮，以便进行轮位控制和状态查询。
actions.description_en: Initialize the filter wheel for position control and status queries.
